'''Grimstone Dungeon''' is a dungeon beneath [[Grimstone]]. It contains the [[Ancient Furnace]], which can smelt cannonballs at double the usual speed; an [[ancient mould]]; and a [[fairy ring]], code {{Fairycode|DLP}}. This fairy ring is only accessible once the player has moored on the island at least once.

You can unnote any metal bar(s) here with [[Isles]] at a cost of 100 [[coins]] per note. Before doing so, however, you need to have sailed to Grimstone and then you must invite him to accompany you there on your boat. He can be found wandering outside the bank at [[Port Roberts]].

Alongside these features, the dungeon is the only location where [[frost dragon]]s reside, located in the centre of the dungeon. To the west of this area is another cave with frost dragons, though these can only be killed on a slayer task. Attempting to attack these dragons outside of a slayer task will result in the message ''"You feel a strange coldness wash over you, filling you with fear. You decide it best not to attack these dragons without permission."''

They can be accessed either by climbing up the rock face from the north or south; the south climb requires 83 [[Agility]], which can be boosted. [[Chilled jelly|Chilled jellies]] can also be found to the north and west of the fairy ring.

Attempting to set up a [[Dwarf multicannon]] anywhere in the dungeon will result in the message ''It's far too cold for you to set up a cannon here.''

==Trivia==
[[File:Grimstone Dungeon - shadow hands.gif|thumb|180px|The shadowy hands that emerge when wearing a ring of visibility or shadows.]]
* There is evidence of [[Xau-Tak]], a mysterious entity associated with the fall of [[Imcandoria]] and the [[Lassar Undercity]], having a presence in the dungeon at one point in time:
** The [[ancient mould]] has an indent that resembles the [[Ancient Pillar]]s found on [[Mos Le'Harmless]] and in the [[Lassar Undercity]] (though the Lassar pillar is much larger). Notably, the mould is described as being "unnaturally cold to the touch", a trait that black stone is said to possess in ''RuneScape 3'', and having a [[blackstone fragment]] in the inventory gives additional dialogue.
** The [[ancient furnace]] and the nearby pillars strongly resemble [[Imcando]] architecture (as seen in [[Camdozaal]] and [[Cam Torum]]). With two dwarven skeletons found nearby as well, this suggests the furnace was once operated by the Imcando prior to the fall of Imcandoria.
** When wearing the [[ring of visibility]] or [[ring of shadows]], shadowy hands can be seen emerging every 28 ticks from ripples in the water near the furnace and mould.
*** The same shadowy hands can be seen emerging from the waters when fighting the [[Judge of Yama (A Kingdom Divided)|Judge of Yama]] during [[A Kingdom Divided]], and they also resemble the hands used in one of [[The Nightmare]]'s attacks.
